usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It gives the expected output on the examples and `wj check` reports no errors or warnings.

I ran both example inputs through `wj run --interpret` (the second as three lines) and they printed `FF`, then `10`, `10100001111` and `0` as required. I did not run `wj build`, as instructed, so the compiled path is untested.

It reads every line from standard input, conv
